'''Lyrobru'''<ref name="AcolyteVG">''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide]]''</ref> was a [[humanoid]] [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that was distinguished by their [[Color|blue]] and tan<ref name="Announcement" /> or brown<ref name="Ever Been to Ghorman" /> skin and [[dog]]-like faces.<ref name="Announcement" /> In the [[Standard year|year]] [[132 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TheAcolyteDate}}</ref> during the [[High Republic Era]], the Lyrobru [[Orlut]] had been detained by the [[Galactic Republic]], breaking free alongside [[Verosha Aniseya]], but being re-apprehended by the [[Jedi Order]] shortly thereafter.<ref name="Acolyte">{{Acolyte|Lost / Found}}</ref> During the reign of the [[Galactic Empire]]<ref name="Announcement" /> in [[5 BBY]],<ref name="Date 5BBY">{{AndorDate|107}}</ref> a member of the species was on the [[planet]] [[Niamos]], lounging on the beaches around [[Pier Nine]].<ref name="Announcement" /> In [[3 BBY]], a Lyrobru was present on the [[planet]] [[Ghorman]].<ref name="Ever Been to Ghorman" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lyrobru, albeit unidentified, first appeared in "[[Announcement]]," the [[Andor Season 1|first season]]'s seventh episode of the [[Disney+]] television series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'',<ref name="Announcement" /> which aired on [[October 19]], [[2022]].<ref name="Release dates">{{Twitter|starwars|status/1557442379975573504|[[Star Wars]]|date=2022-08-10|quote=This is what revolution looks like. Watch #Andor, a Star Wars Original Series, streaming only on @DisneyPlus September 21.|archivedate=20220810191942}}</ref> The species was later identified as Lyrobru in the [[2025]] [[Dorling Kindersley]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide]]'', written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="AcolyteVG" />
